name: @agentic-toolkit/registry
description: The crossing point to @agenticdevelopertoolkit/registry-*. Re-publishes the profile renderer and the field-type catalog so adh sites never name that scope themselves — which is what keeps exactly one copy of it in a bundle — and adds the API client, the editing widgets and the contact composer sites need.

scripts.build: tsup && pnpm run build:types && pnpm run build:css
scripts.build:css: mkdir -p dist/css && cp src/css/profile.css src/css/editor.css dist/css/

//peerDependencies: The two @agenticdevelopertoolkit/* entries are peers for the reason persona's are: the consumer supplies the copy, so a bundle holds one instance rather than one per re-exporting package.
//devDependencies: The two @agenticdevelopertoolkit/* entries are peer deps above — consumers supply them; these link:s exist only so this package can build and test itself. They target THIS repo's own nested submodule at external/adhsdk, so a recursive clone builds with no sibling checkout anywhere on disk. link: rather than workspace:* because that toolkit is a SEPARATE pnpm workspace and pnpm cannot nest workspaces. @agentic-toolkit/auth is a devDependency, not a runtime one: only the ContactComposer test imports AuthHttpError from it, and the component itself reads a thrown failure structurally so the shipped code carries no auth dependency at all.
